..environment: No Node module or Node global

./build.environment: Node only, in development and CI
./build.purpose: Discovery, AST analysis and artifact generation. The four `generate*()` orchestrators and the lower-level primitives are Stable (ADR 0045, `VERSIONING.md`).

./helpers.environment: No Node module; `processors.base64()` returns a Node `Buffer`

./node.environment: Node only, in development and CI
./node.purpose: `nodeBuildFileSystem`, the `BuildFileSystem` adapter a build script hands to `./build`

./evidence.environment: No Node module or Node global
./evidence.purpose: `defineEvidenceProjection`, pure transforms over the Evidence Model (Stable, see `VERSIONING.md`)

./eslint-plugin.environment: Node only, inside the project's ESLint

./schema.purpose: The JSON Schema for `env-cap --json` output (`env-cap-report.schema.json`) and the model schemas under `./schema/*`

dependencies.@typescript/typescript6: The TypeScript 6 compiler the build entry parses schemas with when the project's own TypeScript is 7 or missing (ADR 0049). Bundled inside the tarball. No runtime entry can reach it (`compiler-isolation`).
dependencies.typescript: The project's own compiler, used by the build entry instead of `@typescript/typescript6` when it is version 5 or 6. CI tests the newest 5.x, 6.x and 7.x, not the 5.0 floor.
dependencies.eslint: Only for `@maverickcer/env-cap/eslint-plugin`, which runs inside the project's own ESLint. CI runs the rules on ESLint 10 only.
dependencies.@typescript-eslint/utils: Only for `@maverickcer/env-cap/eslint-plugin`; projects linting TypeScript already have it through `typescript-eslint`.

standards.checkedAgainst: The official OASIS schema (`test/fixtures/standards/`, a managed copy)
standards.limits: A library export, not wired to the CLI. A finding carries a region only when it has a real position. A finding with a position points at the cited file (percent-encoded path); the rest carry a file but no line.
